abstract: Covers DomainKeys Identified Mail (RFC 6376, STD 76) as updated by RFC 8301 (no rsa-sha1, RSA keys of at least 1024 bits, 2048 recommended), RFC 8463 (Ed25519-SHA256), RFC 8553 and RFC 8616: the DKIM-Signature header field and its tags, simple and relaxed canonicalization, header selection and oversigning, the l= body length risk, _domainkey key records, selectors, rotation and revocation, and verification results. It lists three version lines: RFC 6376 (current), RFC 4871 with RFC 5672 (legacy, upgraded from) and the IETF DKIM2 drafts (preview, track). SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions and upgrades, signature tags and signing, canonicalization, keys and DNS, and verification.
